name: cc-knowledge
description: Cultivate durable development lessons into llm-wiki-compatible knowledge.

interface.shortDescription: Extract lessons and publish wiki-backed knowledge.
interface.longDescription: Use Codex skills to extract reusable lessons into an llm-wiki-compatible hub and synthesize cultivated wiki topics into long-form GitHub Discussions posts. Claude-specific hooks and slash commands remain available through the Claude plugin metadata.
defaultPrompt: Extract durable lessons from this session.
Publish a blog post from my wiki topic.
